newsitem.title: australia: ASX substantial shareholding notices - May 20.
newsitem.headline: ASX substantial shareholding notices - May 20.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices have been made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).
Village Roadshow Broadcasting Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Austereo Limited on 16/05/1997, from 146,136,924 ordinary shares (83.88%) to 163,741,865 ordinary shares (93.98%).

- - - - Overseas & General Limited increased its relevant interest in Vietnam Industrial Investments Limited on 14/05/1997, from 25,000,000 ordinary shares (25.25%) to 27,002,000 ordinary shares (26.3%).
The TEN Group Ltd increased its relevant interest in Television & Media Services Limited on 07/05/1997, from 8,750,000 ordinary shares (9.63%) to 11,270,224 ordinary shares (10.78%).

Andale Nominees Pty Limited increased its relevant interest in International Distillers Holdings Limited on 08/05/1997, from 27,640,822 ordinary shares (86.94%) to 27,794,822 ordinary shares (87.42%).
Permanent Trustee Company Ltd increased its relevant interest in Sydney Aquarium Limited on 19/05/1997, from 4,283,139 ordinary shares (20.50%) to 4,758,306 ordinary shares (22.06%).
E.A. Grigg ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Berklee Limited on 19/02/1997.

N.M. Rothschild & Sons (Australia) Pty Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Electrometals Mining Limited on 30/04/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 3,500,000 ordinary shares (7.32%).
N.M. Rothschild & Sons (Australia) Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Ranger Minerals NL on 16/05/1997, from 3,145,523 ordinary shares (5.02%) to 3,764,219 ordinary shares (6.02%).

N.M. Rothschild & Sons (Australia) Pty Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Iron Carbide Australia Limited on 09/05/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 2,209,955 ordinary shares (8.20%).

Permanent Trustee Company Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Target Mining Corporation Limited on 06/05/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 6,050,000 ordinary shares (9.54%).

Guinness Peat Group plc increased its relevant interest in Gibson Chemical Industries Limited between 06/12/96 and 15/05/1997, from 2,097,307 ordinary shares (9.58%) to 2,367,788 ordinary shares (10.82%).
Templeton Worldwide Inc increased its relevant interest in David Jones Limited on 16/05/1997, from 26,897,639 ordinary shares (6.85%) to 30,918,272 ordinary shares (7.87%).
Strategic Pooled Development Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Intag International Limited on 14/05/1997.

Sipa Resources International NL has become entitled to 692,500 ordinary shares in Arcadia Minerals NL at a consideration of 7 ordinary fully paid 20 cent shares in Sipa and 40 cents cash for each 4 ordinary fully paid 20 cent shares in Arcadia pursuant to the takeover offer. Sipa Resources International NL has a total entitlement of 6,956,890 ordinary shares in Arcadia Minerals NL.
Keygrowth Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Techcomm Group Limited on 19/05/1997, from 1,795,400 ordinary shares (5.16%) to 2,210,900 ordinary shares (6.36%).
Deutsche Morgan Grenfall Holdings Australia Limited ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Gullewa Gold NL on 16/05/1997.
